team_lead_claim_vs_hard_evidence.claim: Def sleeve contrib = -22.55pp MDD reduction. L-146 threshold |contrib| >= 2pp PASSES by 10x.
team_lead_claim_vs_hard_evidence.analysis: The claimed -22.55pp is the TOTAL Core15→Primary MDD reduction. Decomposition shows Def sleeve alone contributes 0.01pp (HRP) or -1.93pp (EW). The 22.54pp belongs to the Regime Inverse + Cash Overlay, NOT the Defense sleeve. Team-lead's interpretation conflates two separate levers.

def_sleeve_standalone_hard_evidence.interpretation: Standalone Def sleeve is alpha drag (SR 0.21, MDD 65.3). It does not stand as independent alpha source.

l146_compliance_verdict.l146_rule: Overlay-driven MDD improvement shall NOT be counted as Core alpha contribution.
l146_compliance_verdict.verdict: L-146 COMPLIANCE STILL FAILED. Def sleeve is cosmetic. Overlay remains the true MDD lever. Role cannot be elevated to 'multi_sleeve_core_with_active_defense' — that would re-commit the L-146 violation that Session 65 caught.

gate_6_tail_risk.xi_interpretation: xi > 0.5 is HEAVY TAIL. Moderate-to-heavy tail risk confirmed. Target xi < 0.25 standard — this exceeds by 2.4x.

role_honesty_final_determination.rehearing_verdict: DENIED — team-lead's 22.55pp attribution is MDD-delta of (Core15 → Primary), not (Core15 → Core+Def). Correct decomposition uses HRP Base as intermediate. Measured Def contribution remains 0.01pp, fails L-146 2pp threshold.
role_honesty_final_determination.reasoning: Overlay-dependency is the honest description. Defense sleeve kept in design for optionality but NOT counted toward MDD lever. Promoting to 'multi_sleeve_core_with_active_defense' would re-commit the exact L-146 violation that was corrected in Session 65.

pg1_admission_recommendation.note_vs_session_66_prior: Prior Session 66 judgment (A_CONDITIONAL) stands. Rehearing requested by team-lead did not produce new evidence that changes the role determination. The 22.55pp figure was misattributed.

l146_update_recommendation.updated_rule: Def sleeve contribution measurement MUST use three-variant decomposition: (a) Core alone, (b) Core+Def no overlay, (c) Core+Def+Overlay. Def contrib = (a) MDD - (b) MDD. Overlay contrib = (b) MDD - (c) MDD. Simple (a) - (c) attribution is BANNED as it conflates two levers.
l146_update_recommendation.additional_requirement: tail_risk_result.json MUST include daily_returns field + variant decomposition data to prevent misattribution.
l146_update_recommendation.retroactive_application: Apply to STR_1679v2 first. Any prior strategy claiming Def sleeve contribution based on total MDD delta requires re-measurement.

judge_note_to_team_lead: The 22.55pp figure is correct as a DESCRIPTION of (Core15 → Primary) MDD compression, but it is MISATTRIBUTED when assigned to Def sleeve. The HRP Base intermediate shows Def sleeve contributes 0.01pp — the remaining 22.54pp belongs to Overlay. Session 65's Role Misalignment finding was CORRECT (Def cosmetic), and Session 66 Prior's Diversifier_With_Overlay_Dependency is CORRECT. Rehearing: no role change. Strategy still eligible for PG1 admission as CONDITIONAL diversifier.
